_note: Tier 2, oldest end. Late October 2024, the pre-election prayer run.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that the election will not be rigged, that people will hear the true heart of America, and that everyone will know exactly where America stands with their eyes opened.
mentions.quote: That this will not be a rigged thing
mentions.falsify_match: A 2024 election widely accepted as clean.
mentions.falsify_miss: A contested or disputed result. This is a petition, not a forecast, and the outcome was accepted.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that there be no demonic turnout and no illegal voting, that the outcome be by God's hand, and that God part the sea for America as he did for Israel.
mentions.quote: not have a turnout of demonic voting with illegal people voting
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition about the conduct of an election.

mentions.claim_text: He ranks the three cities he saw attacks in, saying the impression over Nashville was much stronger and came with what he calls a Holy Spirit check, while another was less intense.
mentions.quote: it was a very strong something and then from the holy spirit it's a check
mentions.falsify_match: An attack in Nashville stronger than any in the other two cities named.
mentions.falsify_miss: No Nashville attack. Note the New Orleans attack of 1 January 2025 fell in the city he ranked lowest of the three.

mentions.claim_text: He explains that the Lord gives him assignments and tells him about the Senate, about what is coming and about the attacks, and that their job is to pray, then goes looking for scripture on it.
mentions.quote: I give these assignments and the Lord gives them to me
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an account of how he says he receives material.

mentions.claim_text: Citing Ezekiel 22:30 on finding no one to stand in the gap, he says God has found one today and that they will stand in the gap for America, and recalls seeing a great python coming out of the water of the Gulf of Mexico and wrapping around.
mentions.quote: I saw the great python coming out of the water of the Gulf of Mexico
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a python in the spirit realm over the Gulf has no observable signature.

mentions.claim_text: He returns to Ezekiel 22:30, saying God found no one and has now found them, and encourages the daily audience as those standing in the gap.
mentions.quote: he said but I found no one not even one so he found us
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: exhortation from a scripture reading.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for the men and women they want in the Senate and House, to stand for the unborn, and that First Amendment rights be kept because he says they want the Second Amendment taken away.
mentions.quote: they want to take away your second amendment rights in America
mentions.falsify_match: Federal action removing Second Amendment rights.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such action. Undated, and stated as intent rather than as a dated event.

mentions.claim_text: He says more Asian viewers are joining, and prays for a turnaround in China, in Asia generally, in South Korea and in Japan.
mentions.quote: there's going to be a turnaround in China
mentions.falsify_match: A visible religious turn across China, Korea and Japan.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A petition rather than a forecast, and no measure is given.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that people bound by what he calls false religions from Buddhism onward come to Christ, and declares that Satan has taken his hands off them.
mentions.quote: Satan has taking his hands off of them
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: declarative intercession over conversions.

mentions.claim_text: He compares the three cities again, saying New Orleans is not as strong as Nashville and Las Vegas, that there is something about New Orleans but less than the other two, and describes it as one against many.
mentions.quote: It's not as strong in New Orleans as Tennessee and Nevada
mentions.falsify_match: Attacks in Nashville and Las Vegas larger than anything in New Orleans.
mentions.falsify_miss: The reverse. This is the ranking that matters most in the corpus, because on 1 January 2025 the deadly attack came in New Orleans, the city he twice ranked lowest, and the Las Vegas incident the same day killed only its driver.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for a land free from abortion, for men and women to rise up and vote godly rather than for selfish gain, and for one last plan for the nation under the blood of Christ.
mentions.quote: a land that is free from aborting babies
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition with no event or date.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord has specifically assigned him to pray for America's elections right now, so revival in Asia and Africa will be prayed for later.
mentions.quote: the Lord has specifically put me on the assignment to pray for America's elections
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an account of his own assignment.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls giving a word over a year earlier about an acceleration of war in Europe, tied to the angel released from the pit, and says he believes God can lead liberals out of darkness as Moses did.
mentions.quote: I gave the word about acceleration of war in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: War escalating in Europe following the 2023 word.
mentions.falsify_miss: No escalation beyond the war already running when the word was given.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a private meeting about bringing up a digital platform with the BRICS nations so they could split from the dollar, using a BRICS currency as the global currency alongside Saudi Arabia and the crown prince.
mentions.quote: bringing up a digital platform with the bricks Nations
mentions.falsify_match: A BRICS digital settlement platform displacing the dollar.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such platform. BRICS discussed cross-border payment work publicly through 2024, and no common currency has been issued.

mentions.claim_text: He says something had to be created with Mexico and Canada to make a stronger dollar, and recalls warning about four oak trees seen in darkness, which he says the Lord told him to tell them means four years.
mentions.quote: I saw four oak trees I warned you all about four oak trees
mentions.falsify_match: A four-year period whose end is marked by the events described.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. He hedges the reading himself, saying he believes it is four years rather than stating it.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a speaker rising out of the ground and evangelism coming out of the oak tree, an old 1950s tent revival microphone plugged into a 220 outlet, and the movement going through America.
mentions.quote: the old 1950s Tent Revival microphone was plugged into the 220 outlet
mentions.falsify_match: A national tent revival movement in the style of the 1950s healing revivals.
mentions.falsify_miss: None appears. Undated, but the form is specific enough to recognise.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that something in Texas be exposed, using the image of tearing off a bandage to clean an infected wound that is then purified by the blood.
mentions.quote: in Texas that this will be exposed
mentions.falsify_match: A significant corruption exposure in Texas.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Nothing is named beyond the state, so almost any Texas scandal would fit.

mentions.claim_text: He says something supernatural is about to take place with prayer in Asia and that he saw a great turning there in the spirit realm, adding that he does not know what it all means yet, and that he saw tens or hundreds of thousands praying on this channel for Asia.
mentions.quote: I saw a great turning in Asia in the Spirit realm concerning prayer
mentions.falsify_match: Hundreds of thousands praying with this channel for Asia, which is measurable against its live viewer counts.
mentions.falsify_miss: The audience stays far short. His own on-air count a year later was about 5,500.
